Local frames 381/382/383 are blank, so scroll button sprite visuals are intentionally disabled; the runtime logs the 19x14 hit-zone fallback instead of drawing frame 380 as a false button. EI-original byte identity and pixel parity remain unproved.
observations.safe_plain_chat: PASS: safe ordinary strings were submitted with Return; F350 history and the lower HUD chat bar show [Normal] TestHero messages, and the input line clears.
observations.long_row: PASS: a long safe ordinary string renders as one fixed 14px history row and is clipped horizontally by the history viewport; it does not wrap into adjacent rows.
observations.scrolling: PASS in current Zircon runtime: overflow reaches the bottom and top boundaries; 19x14 fallback hit zones, wheel, rail click/drag and explicit mouse release change the visible range; after manual scroll, a new message remains out of the visible history window. Original EI gauge semantics and exact button sprite pixels remain blocked by local/target resource identity.

verdict: Zircon local runtime verifies F350 input focus, safe plain-chat display, close/reopen, clickable local templates, overflow scrolling, rail interaction, and new-message anchoring. EI-original WIL/WIX byte identity and pixel-level parity remain blocked and are not claimed.
